description: Send a live test event to a webhook on your GrowSurf program using its stored URL and secret. Optionally pass `event` to choose which event type to simulate; when omitted, the webhook's first enabled event is used (returns 400 if the webhook has no enabled events). Returns the mock payload and the receiving endpoint's response. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_test_campaign_webhook

payload.description: The mock event payload that was sent.

response.description: Response returned by the webhook endpoint during the test.

msg.description: Response message returned by the webhook endpoint.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the webhook endpoint.

success.description: Whether the test webhook request completed.

title: Send Test Webhook
